analysis.reasonEn: The upward trend has been maintained for three consecutive trading days since the previous buy signal. RSI is at 58.2, consolidating in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram continues to improve at 33032.4459. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the current price at 1,856,000 KRW compared to the 5-day low of 1,558,000 KRW. Trading volume at 1.12 times the 5-day average remains normal. Weekly ADX at 34.3 confirms a clear trend. 4-hour RSI at 66.0 continues its upward momentum. Overall, the buying pressure is dominant.
